items.note: Controlled experiment on a writing ideation task comparing LLM use from the start versus after independent ideation; LLM-first reduced the number of original ideas and creative self-efficacy; one AI timing versus another, random assignment not stated.

System paper (Scideator) with a user study of computer science researchers comparing it to a baseline using the same LLM without facet modules; outcome is 'creativity support' (likely a self-reported Creativity Support Index), so check whether idea outputs are scored and the N.
The abstract describes itself as a narrative literature review of AI-augmented design creativity; no systematic search or meta-analysis.

2x2 study (GPT-4o-mini conversational cues versus none, crossed with virtual versus in-person) with 172 participants in dyads brainstorming; cued participants' ideas were more topically diverse; abstract from Semantic Scholar, assignment method not stated, unit of analysis is the dyad.

Meta-analysis of 47 RCTs of AI interventions in education on cognitive, social-emotional, and academic outcomes; abstract (from the Springer page) does not mention creativity or generative AI, so it is not a synthesis on generative AI and creativity.

Quasi-experiment with 36 students in teams assigned to immediate AI, delayed AI, or no AI on a problem-solving task; solution homogenisation and creativity scored; below the 50-person threshold and non-random.

Exploratory study with 61 undergraduates in sketching versus AI concept-generation groups on a product design task; quantity, variation, creativity of final concepts, and homogenization assessed; assignment method not stated.

Within-student pre-post design: 45 first-year architecture students' handmade bus-stop designs versus the same designs after AI refinement, rated with a CAT rubric; no comparison group, the authors call it observational, and N is below 50; likely context or exclusion at full-text stage.

Linked course data from 133 art students comparing self-selected AI use intensity with final creative-performance assessment and evaluated authorship, with baseline and propensity-score adjustment; no assigned conditions.

Systematic review and meta-analysis of generative AI and students' creativity (Creativity Research Journal 2026); abstract not reachable via OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC, or the publisher page (403), classified from the title.
